title: Inventory reorder point
summary: A shop reorders a spare part when its stock falls to a reorder point. See how often customers find the shelf empty, and what safety stock buys.
origin: Written for this project: one store with a reorder point, an order quantity and a fixed lead time; answers from the (R, Q) policy with Poisson demand and flow conservation (docs/research/spec-4-template-sources.md).
